title: review-run reconcile --json
description: What reconcile changed (or, with --dry-run, would change). Exit 0 whatever the per-run results. It never signals a process.

already_running.description: true when another reconcile holds the lease; nothing was done (exit 0).

details.description: Closed codes, ids and counts only (for example the resulting state or a throwaway id).

changes.description: What reconcile changed (or, with --dry-run, would change).

warnings.description: Closed list: teardown_stuck (exactly when stuck_teardowns is above 0), audit_stuck (exactly when stuck_audit is above 0), throwaway_leaked (a recorded leaked throwaway remains after its retry).

stuck_teardowns.description: Runs whose teardown failed 5 times or more; the warning teardown_stuck is present exactly when this is above 0.

stuck_audit.description: Events whose audit records are still pending after 5 reconcile passes (audit records retry without bound); the warning audit_stuck is present exactly when this is above 0.
